Create exactly ONE character production asset sheet, 1536x1024, true transparent RGBA background. Reference 1 defines the approved TownGrid pixel sprite rendering style; reference 2 is the old roster, use ONLY the named character for identity, not its tiny chibi proportions or overly detailed rendering.
Character: IDENTITY
Exactly THREE isolated figures with wide transparent gaps: (1) large waist-up portrait of this character on LEFT third x20..650, top100 bottom950; (2) complete smaller sprite in middle x720..1060 top210 bottom920, facing LOWER LEFT SW, visible front chest; (3) same-size complete smaller sprite on right x1160..1510 top210 bottom920, facing UPPER LEFT NW, visible BACK and left cheek, nose points left. Camera looks down at35degrees, azimuth45degrees. Both sprites same head size, same body proportions, full silhouette and limbs unclipped. IMPORTANT third figure is rear-left, not rear-right.
Pixel art with crisp chunky pixel clusters, dark colored outline, 3-4 discrete shadow colors per material, no smooth painting, no glow or colored halo, no scenery, no shadows, no text. Large portrait is matching character in same pixel style, relaxed upright torso, head at top, belt at bottom, hands low; no held prop. Sprites relaxed A pose with arms angled 20degrees away from torso, wrists clear of hips, empty hands, two visible separated straight legs unless species specified differently. Coat hems above thigh so leg joints are visible. Preserve distinct race anatomy and specified colors. Do not copy Mira's face/clothes; match her rendering style. All three figures depict the SAME named character.
